```{r}
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  # Total number of unique combinations possible
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)
  if (n > max_combinations) stop(paste("n exceeds total unique combinations:", max_combinations))
  
  seen <- list()
  result <- list()
  
  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(function(mx) sample(1:mx, size = 1), POSITION_MAX)
    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")
    
    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }
  
  result
}
```

```{r}
icons <- c("🦴", "💀", "🔥", "🪨")
weights <- c(4, 3, 2, 1)
n <- 200

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
# Pick 2 DISTINCT icon types, weighted
run_icons <- sample(
  icons,
  size = 2,
  replace = FALSE,
  prob = weights
)

# Choose which of the two is dominant
dominant <- sample(
  run_icons,
  size = 1,
  prob = weights[match(run_icons, icons)]
)

minor <- setdiff(run_icons, dominant)

# Exactly 9 dominant + 1 minor
icon_sequence <- c(
  rep(dominant, 9),
  minor
)


  icon_sequence <- sample(icon_sequence)

  cat(
    paste0(icon_sequence, collapse = ""),
    "\n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

source("tapho_loader_new.R")
source("augment_metadata_combinations.R")

excel_path <- "hspa.xlsx"

POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)

  if (n > max_combinations) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "n exceeds total unique combinations:",
        max_combinations
      )
    )
  }

  seen <- character()
  result <- list()

  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(
      function(mx) sample(seq_len(mx), size = 1),
      POSITION_MAX
    )

    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")

    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }

  result
}

set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

lvl <- c(2,1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2)

tapho_db <- tapho.loader(
  excel_path,
  level = lvl,
  exclude_sections = c(
    "arms",
    "legs",
    "cranium",
    "shoulder",
    "hands"
  )
)

cat("Rows:", nrow(tapho_db), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(tapho_db), "\n\n")

print(table(
  tapho_db$taphonomic_context,
  useNA = "ifany"
))

glimpse(tapho_db)

```


```{r}
#| label: metadata-augmentation-test

# -----------------------------
# 1. Check expected metadata
# -----------------------------

metadata_cols <- c(
  "geological_period",
  "cultural_period",
  "culture_period_2",
  "start_date_cal_bp",
  "end_date_cal_bp",
  "mis_stage",
  "region",
  "country",
  "karstic_system",
  "open_air_site",
  "age_category",
  "gender",
  "hominin_species"
)

metadata_check <- tibble(
  column = metadata_cols,
  exists = metadata_cols %in% names(tapho_db)
)

print(metadata_check)


# -----------------------------
# 2. Identify skeletal features
# -----------------------------

feature_cols <- setdiff(
  names(tapho_db),
  c(
    names(tapho_db)[1:37],
    "site_id",
    "taphonomic_context"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nNumber of model features:",
  length(feature_cols),
  "\n"
)

print(feature_cols)


# -----------------------------
# 3. Inspect possible groups
# -----------------------------

if ("country" %in% names(tapho_db)) {

  country_groups <- tapho_db |>
    count(
      taphonomic_context,
      country,
      name = "n_sites"
    ) |>
    arrange(
      taphonomic_context,
      desc(n_sites)
    )

  print(country_groups)

  cat("\nGroups with at least 2 observations:\n")

  print(
    country_groups |>
      filter(n_sites >= 2)
  )
}


# -----------------------------
# 4. Start with ONE simple
#    metadata combination
# -----------------------------

test_combos <- list(
  list(
    spatial = "country"
  )
)

my_augment_fun <- make_augment_fun(
  combos         = test_combos,
  feature_cols   = feature_cols,
  target_col     = "taphonomic_context",
  integer_cols   = intersect("mni", names(tapho_db)),
  required_cols  = intersect("mni", names(tapho_db)),
  min_group_size = 2L
)


# -----------------------------
# 5. Run augmentation
# -----------------------------

augmented_db <- my_augment_fun(tapho_db)


# -----------------------------
# 6. Compare before / after
# -----------------------------

cat(
  "\n-----------------------------\n",
  "AUGMENTATION RESULT\n",
  "-----------------------------\n",
  "Original rows:  ", nrow(tapho_db), "\n",
  "Augmented rows: ", nrow(augmented_db), "\n",
  "Synthetic rows: ",
  nrow(augmented_db) - nrow(tapho_db),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nOriginal class counts:\n")

print(
  table(
    tapho_db$taphonomic_context,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat("\nAfter augmentation:\n")

print(
  table(
    augmented_db$taphonomic_context,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)
```
